apiResources.title: Business Partner Relationship (Version 1)
apiResources.shortDescription: Creates, reads, updates and deletes business partner relationships
apiResources.description: This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete business partner relationships for a specific supplier user ID. A business partner relationship maps the included supplier user ID to additional business entities, enabling the user ID to act on behalf of any business entity that it is mapped to.
